## Installation

Download the released `zip` file and extract it to your `mpv/scripts` directory.
The archive contains the `videoclip/` script directory.

Alternatively, clone the repository and run `make install`:

```bash
git clone 'https://github.com/Ajatt-Tools/videoclip.git'
cd videoclip
make install
```

If you want to start from the example configuration, download `videoclip.conf`
and save it to `~/.config/mpv/script-opts/videoclip.conf`.

See [Installation](https://github.com/Ajatt-Tools/videoclip#installation) and
[Configuration](https://github.com/Ajatt-Tools/videoclip#configuration) for details.
